meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan 👍 ₹700 ke andar acne-prone skin ke liye **Salicylic Acid** serum meri first choice hogi—especially agar pimples, blackheads ya oily skin hai.

### 🥇 Meri top pick
### [Minimalist Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹224*

**Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — around ₹495–₹549 for 30 ml. Brand ke according ye acne, blackheads aur excess oil ke liye formulated hai, fragrance-free aur non-comedogenic bhi hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/serums-acne-acne-prone-skin/products/salicylic-acid-2?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Kaise use karein:**  
- Raat ko face wash ke baad **2–3 drops**
- Starting mein **alternate nights**
- Irritation na ho toh gradually daily use kar sakte ho
- Subah **sunscreen zaroor**

### Agar acne marks + oily skin zyada hai
### [Minimalist Niacinamide Face Serum]()
*₹237*

**Minimalist Niacinamide 10%** ~₹570. Ye sebum/oil control, pores aur acne marks ke liye better option hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/products/niacinamide-10-with-matmarine?_pos=4&_sid=c2e5d3891&_ss=r&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Simple choice:**  
- 🔴 **Active pimples/blackheads → Salicylic Acid 2%**
- 🟤 **Acne marks + oiliness → Niacinamide 10%**
- 😣 **Sensitive/dry skin → Niacinamide 5%** (gentler option) [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/treatments/products/niacinamide-5-face-serum-10ml?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar tum mujhe bata do **skin oily/dry/combination hai aur acne kaisa hai (small bumps, whiteheads, painful pimples ya marks)**, toh main ₹700 ke andar **exact 1 serum** recommend kar dunga.
